blind.description: An architectural wall bracket or corbel styled with a fantasy spider theme. The top forms a flat rectangular shelf bordered in beige stone with a dark purple inset displaying a white spider symbol. Beneath the shelf, an integrated stylized lavender and white spider forms the structural support, clinging to an ornamental stone L-shaped bracket. Surfaces are clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: A rectangular shelf oriented vertically in view, framed by beige stone trim with a dark purple center panel bearing a white spider emblem, with the sculpted spider legs slightly visible protruding from beneath the sides.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 3 feet tall (roughly mid-thigh to waist height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 1.5 feet wide.

notes: underside: the mesh's middle is not over what touches the floor (leaning or cantilevered)
